title: High-redshift metallicity anchors: evolution versus calibration
short_title: An apparent metallicity offset has two explanations
tts_instructions: Measured scientific-conference narration in Alloy. Calm, precise, and authoritative. Preserve the Kewley and Ellison abstract sentence verbatim. Voice it as an attributed report from another study, never as this video’s finding. Keep the calibration-versus-evolution question open and the interpretation disputed. Do not imply that a result, offset sign, abundance difference, calibration verdict, or evolution verdict has been revealed.

sentences.text: At high redshift, metallicity relations can disagree because galaxies evolved, or because calibrations changed the measuring scale.

sentences.text: The absolute metallicity scale (y-int) varies up to 0.7 dex, depending on the calibration used.
Kewley and Ellison reported disagreement among the measurement rulers; the interpretation remains disputed, and this video adopts no answer as its finding.
sentences.display_citation: Lana lane ruling · claimed and disputed · no winner

params.heading: WHAT THE LITERATURE BEAT DOES NOT DECIDE

sentences.text: Counting metallicity rows cannot settle that question, because a table entry is not yet a direct-temperature anchor on a common scale.

params.heading: WHY A ROW COUNT CANNOT SETTLE IT
params.bottom: A NUMBER BECOMES AN ANCHOR ONLY THROUGH ITS EVIDENCE CHAIN

sentences.text: Even an auroral-line label is insufficient without flux uncertainty, abundance-capable companion lines, stellar mass, and provenance that can reproduce the derivation.

params.heading: THE AMBIGUITY CONTINUES AFTER LINE DISCOVERY
params.left: FLUX + ERROR + LINE SET + MASS + PROVENANCE
params.right: A LABEL WITHOUT A REPRODUCIBLE ABUNDANCE CHAIN
params.bottom: THE CHAIN, NOT THE COLUMN NAME, DEFINES THE ANCHOR

sentences.text: The discriminating chain begins with a source-published auroral flux and uncertainty, judged under one predeclared quality rule.
A frozen line-ratio pipeline then carries the accepted fluxes into electron temperature without selecting a convenient recipe after inspection.

params.heading: FLUX RATIOS BECOME TEMPERATURE UNDER ONE PIPELINE

sentences.text: That temperature becomes a direct oxygen abundance only when the required ionic channels survive, while every refusal stays explicit.
The direct abundance is joined to the same object's stellar mass and projected onto one declared direct-temperature reference scale.
sentences.display_citation: Same-object mass join · declared anchor frame

params.heading: JOIN THE SAME OBJECT, THEN DECLARE THE SCALE

sentences.text: Only after seam, lensing, and scale controls pass can the common-scale comparison ask which explanation fits, without answering it in this canary.
The source ledger preserves enumeration, candidate rows, contract-grade anchors, and matched-mass bins as changing units, with every result count removed here.
sentences.display_citation: Anchor workflow · result counts not displayed

params.heading: KEEP THE UNIT ATTACHED TO EACH STAGE

sentences.text: Because no sibling source freeze exists, the method keeps the pipeline stages but drops table totals, anchor totals, mass-bin occupancy, and every derived value.

params.heading: DROP UNSAFE VALUES, KEEP THE METHOD
params.banner: NO SOURCE FREEZE · NO NUMBER CARD

sentences.text: The estimator is a common-scale direct-abundance difference at matched stellar mass, built symbolically and left unevaluated.

params.heading: BUILD THE ESTIMATOR WITHOUT REVEALING IT

sentences.text: Scale uncertainty travels beside statistical uncertainty, so a visual offset cannot silently become a physical-evolution claim.

params.heading: THE SCALE TERM DEFINES THE CLAIM

sentences.text: The auroral-quality control tests noise and blending, while the line-completeness control tests whether a temperature can become an abundance.

params.heading: CONTROL THE PHYSICS OF THE ANCHOR

sentences.text: The mass-join, lensing, and scale controls prevent the same derived abundance from supporting incompatible physical interpretations.
We tied our own hands by freezing anchor classes, quality rules, derivation physics, and the declared reference scale before computing any abundance.

params.bottom: THE METHOD CANNOT MOVE AFTER ABUNDANCES ARE SEEN

sentences.text: The gates are scientific discipline: no missing flux, mass, magnification, or uncertainty can be repaired with an assumption chosen after inspection.

params.bottom: AN ABSENT INPUT REMAINS AN EXCLUSION

sentences.text: What is known is the anchor-building method; table counts, anchor yield, mass-bin occupancy, offset sign, and any evolution verdict remain outside this canary.
Ask the opening question again: would a common-scale offset belong to young galaxies, or to the calibration process?

params.heading: EVOLUTION OR CALIBRATION?
params.discriminant: DIRECT-TEMPERATURE CHAIN + COMMON SCALE + MATCHED MASS
params.banner: METHOD DESIGNED · VALUE AND SIGN WITHHELD

sentences.text: Now we have a method that can separate those explanations without manufacturing an anchor count, an offset, or a result.
